steps: Identify the absolute refractory period as the time during an action potential when a second action potential cannot be initiated.
Recall the states of voltage-gated Na+ channels: resting (closed), activated (open), and inactivated.
During the absolute refractory period, the Na+ channels are in the inactivated state and cannot be opened by any stimulus.
Therefore, the primary cause of the absolute refractory period is the inactivation of voltage-gated Na+ channels.
